fields.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad and Tawassul with the Prophet ﷺ
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Mufliḥ and Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Aḥmad said in his Manāsik: He makes Tawassul with the Prophet ﷺ in his Duʿāʾ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This passage is not evidence for Duʿāʾ to the Prophet ﷺ or for grave rituals. The permitted meaning is delimited directly by Īmān, obedience, love, Ṣalāh and Salām, as well as by Duʿāʾ and Shafāʿah.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Mufliḥ, al-Furūʿ wa-Taṣḥīḥ al-Furūʿ, Kitāb aṣ-Ṣalāh, Bāb Ṣalāt al-Istisqāʾ, Bd. 3, S. 229 / Islamweb Teil 2, S. 160.
immutable.scholar: Ibn Mufliḥ und Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal
